CLIMATE DETECTIVE — Discovering Earth’s Hidden Climate Trends

Climate Detective is an interactive web platform designed to make climate data easier to explore and understand. Using NASA’s MERRA-2 climate dataset, the project transforms monthly temperature observations into interactive maps, time-series charts, and regional trend visualizations. Users can investigate temperature patterns across different parts of the world, examine changes over time, and discover regions with similar climate behavior through machine-learning clustering. The platform also provides downloadable PDF reports to help communicate findings.

Climate change is a global challenge, but large scientific datasets can be difficult for the public to interpret. Climate Detective bridges this gap by turning complex NASA data into accessible visual insights, encouraging climate awareness, scientific curiosity, and more informed discussions about our changing planet.
